description: Language-neutral vectors for the single Smarthost address-normalisation rule (docs/architecture/conventions.md, Email addresses). PHP (app/tests/Unit/AddressNormalizerVectorsTest.php) and Python (validator/tests/test_normalize.py) consume this file unchanged; Go must use it from Phase 4. Expected values were produced by the approved PHP/ICU implementation. normalized = null means there is no normalised address. Normalisation is not validation: syntactically invalid addresses can still have a normalised form.
rule: trim surrounding ASCII whitespace only: SP, HT, LF, VT, FF, CR
split at the final @; local part and domain must both be non-empty
preserve the local part byte-for-byte; never case-fold it
lower-case an all-ASCII domain (ASCII lower-casing only, no other processing)
convert a domain containing non-ASCII to A-labels with UTS #46 non-transitional processing (CheckHyphens, CheckBidi, CheckJoiners, no STD3 rules, DNS length limits) and lower-case the result
a failed conversion means there is no normalised address
